actual_scope: Classify exactly when the inherited conservative CRT reservoir 3 r_max envelope fits the printed p/6400 allowance for every precision and width pattern at fixed p and dyadic axis count d; construct attaining failures and exclude a p-only cutoff.
scope_change_reason: This is an original quantified arithmetic question beyond the single-layout comparisons in PR4923/4925/4926. The card is changed from formalization/audit to a written unbounded theorem and exact finite corroboration. No predecessor result is reverified as a deliverable.
bottleneck_link: Separates a sufficient repair-room estimate from the actual L<=p premise. The new sharp axis-capacity criterion can certify arbitrarily long addresses, and proves that increasing p alone does not cover an unconstrained axis count. Actual error, physical repair and complete supplier admission remain separate.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved universal capacity criterion with an attaining source-bound counterexample; package it without optimizing the actual error or changing the envelope.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the unbounded theorem. The standalone warning-strict normal/optimized verifier checks exact integer inequalities, exhaustive finite width-count patterns, attaining precisions, capacity boundaries, actual Layout fixtures and rejecting controls.
